status: SHIPPED - raws in raw/, exported by export_assets.py; this file and make_guide.py own the geometry
registration: Reuse the Specter v2 export canvases and inner-hinge pivots so the existing shell pose tracks drive the rig. Every body part keeps the complete canvas; never trim or recenter a shoulder.

torso.joint_backing: dark flexible backing continuous under both shoulder cuts, 40 source px overlap at the master's resolution

left-shoulder.note: the boarding shield: a long welded loading-frame plate hung on the left hinge. Its forward lip stands ahead of the chest; the shield turns with the torso (armor master turn gain), so when the rig twists into aim, fire or brace the lip sweeps across the chest front. The Latch Assist rams are bolted to its back face: this slab is the Latch Assist screen, no separate carrier layer

right-shoulder.note: a smaller rounded cargo-frame cap from a different donor

head.shape: compact pressure helmet: low oval dome inside the socket, flat welded brow plate forward, two guarded hose ports aft

foot.shape: broad flat cargo boot with toe plate forward and a heel latch; two walking feet, no tracks or claws

weapon.note: Handheld weapons stay the shared swappable infantry layers. The rig adds no weapon art and no extra gun.

casing.note: welded replacement plate; paint masks recolor this only

hoses.note: guarded hose runs in armored sleeves

service_labels.note: hand-lettered panels with no readable text

indicator.note: at most one tiny lamp per part

coordinate_note: Normalized canvas coordinates, origin top-left, Y down; up is forward (north).
